lines.text: Prompt-to-M-D folds it into clean Markdown.
Paste the mess. Hit Fold it.
Structured Markdown, an honest token count, and no API key.
Too long? Fold fourteen hundred tokens to under five hundred.
Other tools cut and hope. This folds.
Unfold any summary. The exact original comes back.
It plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, and any M-C-P client.
Open source. Try it at prompt-to-M-D dot vercel dot app.

bgm.query: warm minimal cinematic electronic underscore, soft pulsing synth bass, glassy plucks, confident and premium, opens up when the fold happens, resolves at the end
bgm.blob: Paste any messy prompt: prompt2md folds it into token-optimized Markdown with honest token numbers, and unfolds anything it summarized back to the byte-exact original.
bgm.arc: Hook (the mess, in ink) → Turn (the fold, into paper) → Proof (live demo, the ledger, long context) → Difference (cut vs fold, the unfold) → Reach → Command
